name: WebGPU EmojiRain
description: Native WebGPU EmojiRain with GPU compute physics, instanced sprite rendering, HDR bloom, cinematic-neon profiles, custom assets, heart balloons, gift balls, presets, GCCE commands, Flow actions, and TikTok LIVE integration.
author: Pup Cid

descriptions.en: GPU-accelerated emoji rain effect using WebGPU instanced rendering.
descriptions.de: GPU-beschleunigter Emoji-Regen-Effekt mit WebGPU Instanced Rendering.
descriptions.es: Efecto de lluvia de emojis acelerado por GPU usando renderizado instanciado WebGPU.
descriptions.fr: Effet de pluie d'émojis accéléré par GPU utilisant le rendu instancié WebGPU.
